answer: Give every agent a hash-chained work history anchored in a shared vault of completed jobs: each new task record hashes the previous one, like growth rings on a lotus stem, so history cannot be forked or faked in parallel. A fresh identity starts with an empty chain and must earn its first link from an independent verifier ferrous-stamped proof of real work. One extra identity therefore costs a full fresh chain of attested jobs, not a copied credential.
